recorded_failure.observed: waiting diagnostic without a heartbeat before fixed-time holder release

root_cause: The holder released after 0.45 seconds measured before waiter startup, so outer-pool load could consume the proof window.
The first synchronized form still used an unrelated 8-second queue-state poll; controlled repetition 34 reproduced that startup race.
fix: Hold the capacity-1 lease behind an explicit release file until the real waiter emits a flushed heartbeat.
Wait directly for the diagnostic event with a 30-second bound and fail early on child exit.
Refresh the final child diagnostic after exit and release/reap only the exact probe processes.

controlled_repetitions.before_final_fix: 33 passed then the unrelated state-poll startup race reproduced at repetition 34

verification.canonical_units: 18 of 18 passed on initial attempts; no serial retry
verification.cleanup: An outer-shell timeout left only the exact P1.16 waiter child; its run-id/PID chain was validated and stopped, its stale ticket was reaped by the next legitimate acquisition, and P2.35 remained untouched.
